newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal inflation seen at 3.2-3.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal inflation seen at 3.2-3.3 pct.

text.p: Portugal's inflation, measured as a rolling 12-month average, will stand at 3.2-3.3 percent by the end of 1996, Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said on Friday.
The rate would be inside the government's forecast of a 3.0-3.5 percent range.
However, in recent weeks the government had been suggesting that the rate could be closer to the bottom end of the range.
The moving average stood at 3.3 percent in September when the year-on-year rate was 3.4 percent.
The government's 1997 budget programme calls for an average inflation of 2.25 to 2.50 percent next year.
